knownCoordination.description: MISO states the BECI lines will interconnect with ATC-owned facilities; its March 2025 RFP scope table assigns the Columbia (50950) and Sugar Creek (51027) substation modifications to ATC. The selection report lists planned coordination with interconnecting transmission owners on regulatory, permitting, design, construction and O&M activities as an important aspect for developers to address, and says (in its real-time operations section) that line owners will coordinate with the owners/controllers of the terminal substations; MGS's map legend says substation connection points are determined by local utilities. MISO also noted Transource's proposal lacked specificity on TO coordination at points of interconnection. This is planned/required interconnection coordination; no executed agreement, shared crews, equipment or other resource sharing is documented.

projects.parentInitiative: MISO LRTP Tranche 2.1 (MTEP24, Projects 26/30/31) - BECI competitive project facility set
caveats: Developer identity: MISO's selection report and news release name Transource, Inc. (the report's proposal list says 'Transource LLC'); Transource/AEP/MGS materials say the project is being developed by Midcontinent Grid Solutions, a 50/50 JV of Transource Energy and BHE Transmission, and AEP says BHE Transmission will own 50% of the project. The report says MISO and Transource will execute the Selected Developer Agreement within 60 days; execution not confirmed in cached sources.
MGS's August 2026 news release expands BECI as 'Bell Center – Columbia – Illinois/Wisconsin State Line' (omitting Sugar Creek); MISO, Transource and the MGS fact sheet map include Sugar Creek.

Completion claims differ: MISO/Transource require in service by June 1, 2034; AEP (Jan 2026) said a 2034 in-service date; MGS (Sept 2026) anticipates in service in 2033. Not strictly contradictory (2033 is before the deadline) but the target moved.
Construction window comes from a developer planning schedule marked approximate and pre-CPCN; the PSCW has not approved the project or a route as of 2026-09-26.
Coordinates are terminal points only (named substations from OSM; western point is Bell Center village centroid; state-line point is Rock County centroid). No route geometry exists.
Counties are the MGS study area (nine counties), not a final route; a county listing does not mean construction in every county.

Project id 'atc-nspw-grid-forward' is a placeholder shared with the Dairyland cluster; Grid Forward's applicants are ATC, NSPW, SMMPA Wisconsin and WPPI Energy (final decision p.1), so its owner set may need more than atc/xcel-nspw. New utility ids used here: bhe-transmission, comed, gridliance-heartland.

Date encoding is interpretive: 'Late YYYY' encoded as July-December and 'Summer' as June-September, both with precision 'quarter' as the closest enum value. MISO's 'placed into service by June 1, 2034' is a deadline encoded as a single day; it is not a forecast in-service date.
